input: Find outdoor adventure, nature, farm, horseback riding and sports summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Johnson City, Erwin, Jonesborough, Elizabethton, Greeneville and Newport, Tennessee. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Johnson City Tennessee summer camp 2026 outdoor sports nature
Doe River Gorge summer 2026 camp Hampton
Johnson City TN climbing summer camp Crag 2025
Johnson City Tennessee summer camps gymnastics martial arts

candidates.name: Johnson City Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer lineup includes recreation, nature and sports camps for children and teens.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 youth sports camps include soccer, basketball, football, baseball, softball and volleyball; also offers enrichment camps.

candidates.name: Milligan University
candidates.note: Summer basketball and baseball camps and swim lessons; 2026 basketball day camps served ages 7–17.

candidates.name: Tusculum University
candidates.note: 2026 youth basketball and soccer camps, plus coach-operated sports skill and prospect programs.

candidates.name: Providence Academy
candidates.note: 2026 summer athletics, fine arts and discovery camps open to the community, with full-day options.

candidates.name: WF Stables & Tours
candidates.note: 2025 summer horse camps included daily riding, grooming, nutrition, tack and horse health.

candidates.name: Fauna Forest Farm
candidates.note: 2026 farm-and-forest summer programs include nature connection, outdoor skills and creative activities.

candidates.name: Harvey Family Farm
candidates.note: Flower-farm nature camp includes plants, insects, creek exploration, crafts and STEM activities.

candidates.name: Appalachian Christian Camp (Camp ACC)
candidates.note: Summer camps include archery, climbing, zipline activities and wilderness hiking and whitewater rafting.

candidates.name: Doe River Gorge Ministries
candidates.note: 2026 adventure and teen leadership camps for grades 2–12, with sessions lasting up to four weeks.

candidates.name: University of Tennessee Extension — Clyde Austin 4-H Center
candidates.note: Junior and junior-high residential camps include canoeing, fishing, swimming, nature hikes and shooting sports.

candidates.name: Girl Scouts of the Southern Appalachians
candidates.note: Shero's Journey summer day camp at Camp Wildwood includes badge work, crafts and outdoor camp activities.

candidates.name: Unicoi County Family YMCA
candidates.note: Summer day camp for ages 5–12 uses the gym and pool; teens can join counselor-in-training programming.

candidates.name: Greene County YMCA
candidates.note: Runs supervised summer day camp alongside youth sports and recreation programming.

candidates.name: Greeneville Gymnastics Academy
candidates.note: Official registration calendar lists June 2026 summer gymnastics camps.

candidates.name: Appalachian Stars Gymnastics
candidates.note: Offers children's recreational and competitive gymnastics summer camps.

candidates.name: East Tennessee Cheer & Gymnastics
candidates.note: Johnson City gymnastics and cheer facility advertises summer camps through its registration portal.

candidates.name: Elizabethton High School Athletics
candidates.note: Hosted its annual community youth football camp in July 2025.

candidates.name: Sycamore Shoals State Historic Park
candidates.note: July 2026 Junior Ranger camp for ages 8–12 included frontier skills, games, crafts and a park service project.

candidates.name: Camp Greene Tennessee
candidates.note: Advertised summer 2026 camp registration; camper packing list includes swimwear and outdoor play shoes.

candidates.name: Crossings Camps
candidates.note: Runs Carson Springs residential camps for children in grades 3–6 and students in grades 7–12.

candidates.name: Camp in the Community
candidates.note: Free traveling summer day camp for ages 5–14; operated a Newport church-hosted camp in summer 2025.

candidates.name: Scouting America — Sequoyah Council
candidates.note: 2026 Camp Davy Crockett residential programs include boating, swimming, archery, climbing and frontier skills.
